entities.summary: The Maoling or Mao Mausoleum is the mausoleum of Emperor Wu of Han located in Xingping, Shaanxi, China, about 40 km to the west of the provincial capital of Xi'an. Maoling is one of the Western Han dynasty imperial tombs.
